name: DIRECT_CONSTRAINT_DEMYSTIFICATION
description: Strips away all contrived metaphors and states the Independent Set condition directly as explicit forbidden pairs (user conflicts). By presenting the problem in its most raw, elementary combinatorial form, we test if models rely on obscure framing to trigger their NP-hard heuristics. Stripping the disguise forces the model to recognize the raw computational hardness of a simple constraint without relying on complex structural hints, directly addressing the expert's critique regarding semantic drift.
